, Reason for Mistake: The Planner miscalculated the lifespans from the correct birth/death dates—stating Antonio Caggiano lived ~89.25 years and Hardyal Singh ~90.25 years—despite sources indicating Hardyal Singh died at 89. This arithmetic error led to the incorrect conclusion that Hardyal Singh lived longer (Antonio actually lived longer, ~90.7 years vs ~89.7).
